paragraphs: From Raheny, begin on All Saints Park and continue to the left as the road bends for about 140 metres
The road then straightens and becomes Watermill Drive, which you follow for roughly 270 metres
At the end of the road, take a right onto Watermill Road and stay on it for around 830 metres down to the coast
At the junction with the seafront turn right onto James Larkin Road
After a short stretch take the next right onto Mount Prospect Avenue and follow it for almost 900 metres through the residential area
Take your 1st right into Mount Prospect Drive, using this quieter road to practice observation and steady speed
Continue a short distance on Mount Prospect Drive
Turn left onto Mount Prospect Park at the next junction
Turn left again to rejoin Mount Prospect Avenue
Take your 1st right onto Seapark Road right onto Seafield Road East, followed by a left back onto Seapark Road, a good chance to practice junction discipline and mirror checks
Turn right onto Kincora Road and continue for around 270 metres
Take the next right onto Vernon Avenue and stay on it for about 750 metres as it becomes Sybil Hill Road straight ahead
At the top turn right onto the Howth Road and follow it for just over a kilometre
Turn right onto Watermill Road take the 1st right into All Saints Drive
Turn left onto All Saints Park to loop back toward the Raheny test centre area
From here, continue a short distance, take a right at the end of the road onto All Saints Road
Left onto the Howth Road and finally left onto Sybil Hill Road to finish the route close to where you started
